title: periballia minuta
intro: Periballia minuta, commonly known as the Tiny Ball plant, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family of Gesneriaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
